notes: RANKED PLAY: two new online playlists, RANKED HARDPOINT and RANKED SEARCH & DESTROY (4 v 4). Every match moves your skill rating (SR): wins add, losses take, how you played nudges it, and leaving early costs 25. The first 5 are placement matches. Climb SEED, SPROUT, BUD, FLOWER, TOP SHELF to KUSH KING.
DAILY JOBS: three small jobs every day at the top of THE PLUG'S LIST (WEEKLY), 1,200 XP and 100 DZ each.

CREWS: make a crew with a name and a 2-4 letter tag, or join a friend's, in the friends leaderboard's new CREW tab. Your tag shows by your name in online matches, and the CREW tab ranks your crew. The leaderboard also gets a RANKED tab.

EVENTS: HAUNTED HARVEST starts tomorrow (Oct 24 - Nov 2): double XP, and play 3 matches for its calling card. Also coming: a DOUBLE XP WEEKEND on the first weekend of every month, the SEASON FINALE (Dec 26-31) and the 4/20 FESTIVAL (double XP, +420 DZ a match and a calling card).
